MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 26

3. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 3
   C. 17
   D. 21

4. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x = 5
   C. x ≥ 0 only
   D. x < 5

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 169
   C. 26
   D. 170

7. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 9
   D. 82

8. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 73
   B. 1
   C. 72
   D. 17

9. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

10. Solve for x: x + 3 = 7. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 3
   D. 7

11. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 57
   B. 56
   C. 1
   D. 15

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 10 000 m²

13. Solve for x: x + 8 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 8
   C. 8
   D. 7

14. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

16. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 1

17. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/2

18. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

19. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 156
   C. 144
   D. 24

20. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 49
   D. 50

21. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 7
   C. 1
   D. 12

22. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

23. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 33

24. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 36
   D. 12

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
